what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved a de minimis change to the Lunenburg Central plan, contingent on review by its peer review engineer.
The board closed the Cross Street/Mopus Road hearing and approved the stormwater permit decision as drafted.
The board approved an ANR for 44 Northfield Road and re-signed the approved plan for Reservoir Road.
The board granted its annual MRPC GIS hours to the Conservation Commission for trail mapping grant work, without setting a number of hours.
Committee reports said the capital planning committee ranked the master plan fifth of its requests, and that funding availability is not yet known.

why_it_matters: The Lunenburg Central approval is conditional, so the engineer's review of the revised plan decides whether the change stands, and it will come back to the board.
The stormwater permit decision is final for the Cross Street/Mopus Road project, which affects neighbors there.
Whether the master plan is funded depends on how much money the town manager makes available for capital requests, a figure not yet known.
watch_next: The applicant's representative is to invite the review engineer to the next Planning Board meeting, set for January 24.
The town manager's funding availability for capital requests, which decides how many of the ranked requests can be funded.
